headlines.text: Rewind to 2021, when it was title-change night for the AEW TNT Title as Sammy Guevara vs. Miro battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.40 ? a strong outing ? ending the champion's reign at 7 defenses. Ending a dominant undefeated singles reign, capped on a deeply meaningful night dedicated to the memory of the late Brodie Lee in his own hometown ? Guevara's best friend Fuego Del Sol helped set up the finish, sending Miro into his own exposed turnbuckle before the 630 splash sealed the title win.
Looking back to 2023, when Hikaru Shida vs. Ruby Soho met in a Number One Contender, serving as the night's main event on Rampage, rated 7.21 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.

Flash back to 2021, when Jungle Boy chalked up their 50th recorded AEW match ? a real marker of consistency, facing Adam Cole vs. Jungle Boy, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 7.69 ? a match that delivered.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2023: Acclaimed & B.Gunn vs. Hardys & Zay fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Trios Titles, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.37. It was the first title opportunity of Hardys & Zay's career.

Looking back to 2023, when Eddie Kingston vs. Rocky Romero clashed for the NJPW STRONG Openweight Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.20. For Rocky Romero, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
